acceptanceCriteria: A replay over at least 50 merged PRs with re-pushes shows zero reused-pass where the full rerun failed.
Spec with failure modes and rollback accepted by the owner.
body: Found 2026-10-10 by the CI audit (report /private/tmp/claude-501/gotmp/ci-audit.md; 60 ci.yml runs; main run 38055182050). PR wall median 39.8 min, critical path always go-product-shard 0. Extend AFP-V0-024 beyond whole-tree identity: for each bounded-reader package, digest transitive Go inputs, declared read-scope files (AFP-V0-023), toolchain and argv/env identity; reuse a passed record from a trusted run (main or the same PR's earlier head) with an equal digest. UNBOUNDED_READER units and any digest error run the test (fail closed). Needs a new spec.
title: affected: per-package verified test-result reuse keyed by input-closure digest
